title: Derived affine mate factors through the ordinary pushforward unit
statement: Let $R,A,B,D$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebra structures on $A,B$ and an $(A\otimes_R B)$-algebra structure on $D$. Set $E=A\otimes_R B$, $\alpha:E\to D$, $j:B\to E$, and let $\phi:A\to D$ and $\psi:B\to D$ be the two restrictions of $\alpha$. Assume the spectrum square with maps $f:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $g:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $p:\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, $f':\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ commutes. Assume the sheaf derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and module derived categories over $R,B$ exist. Let $M$ be an unbounded $A$-K-flat complex [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], let $K\in D_{QCoh}(\operatorname{Spec}A)$, and let $e:Q(\widetilde M)\cong K$. Assume the derived p-pullback counit on the homotopy object of $\widetilde M$ is invertible. Fix $i\in\mathbb Z$ and the fixed tensor model $m$ [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Let $C=D\otimes_A M$ formed with the restriction of $\alpha$ to $A$, and $C_g=D\otimes_{A,\phi}M$. Let $c_E$ be $m.comparison(i)$ followed by homology of $m.ordinaryToLocalized$ followed by the exact-restriction homology isomorphism. Let $\rho:\operatorname{res}_\psi\cong\operatorname{res}_j\operatorname{res}_\alpha$ be the identity-on-carriers scalar comparison. Put $s=\operatorname{res}_j(c_E)\circ\rho_{H^i(C)}^{-1}$ and let $z_0:H^i(C)\to H^i(C_g)$ be the equality transport from the specified restriction of $\alpha$ to $\phi$. Define $t:Q(\widetilde{C_g})\cong Lp^*K$ to be the inverse of the unit-normalized termwise tensor-pullback isomorphism, followed by the inverse derived pullback counit and $Lp^*e$ [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-coordinates; lem-weil-pbc-tilde-pullback-base-change]. With $T=\widetilde{(-)}$ on $B$-modules, $H=H^i$ on sheaves over $\operatorname{Spec}B$, and the explicit ordinary-to-derived pushforward map $q_{C_g}$ [lem-pc-affine-tilde-pushforward-cohomology-normalization], there is an isomorphism $e_C:T(\operatorname{res}_j(m.cohomology(i)))\cong H(Lg^*Rf_*K)$ such that $e_C\circ H(\beta_K)=T(s)\circ T(\operatorname{res}_\psi z_0)\circ q_{C_g}\circ H(Rf'_*t)$, in diagrammatic order, where $\beta$ is the pinned derived mate [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. This is a factorization through the ordinary pushforward complex; it asserts no natural target cohomology presentation. No quasi-coherence assumption on $Lp^*K$, cartesian assumption, or coefficient-map invertibility is required.

proof.text: Apply the identity-representative factorization to Q(tilde M). Quasi-coherence follows by transporting hK across homology of e inverse.

Prove mate naturality for an arbitrary comparison natural transformation from the adjunction Hom equivalence, comparison naturality and counit naturality; no inverse is used. Specialize to the hom of the pinned pullback composition-comparison isomorphism. Compose the identity-case source isomorphism with homology of derived pullback of derived pushforward of e; apply the proved naturality at e.hom.
Use the explicit representative identity-transport equation, map composition and reassociation to identify the final factor with the representative for K and e.
